justification: DCP Controls card gets its own full-width row so the long PDF URL is readable, and URL fields (DCP URL, Legislation URL) render as styled clickable links ('Open the DCP document (PDF) ↗') instead of raw overflowing addresses.

pre_impl.existing_data: spanFor() already maps sections to grid spans; the dcp_controls section carries a DCP URL field. Values rendered as raw strings via FieldValue's predecessor.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A long PDF URL in a single tile overflowed/was unreadable; it should be a link, and the card needs room.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Adds FULL_ROW_SECTIONS (dcp_controls -> full row) and a FieldValue component that renders http(s) values as labelled links; reused in both the DataField and plain value branches.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Pure display; non-URL values render unchanged via the display string.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: DCP card squeezed in a tile with a raw overflowing URL. After: DCP card spans the row; the URL is a clickable 'Open the DCP document (PDF)' link; legislation URLs likewise.

functions.name: FieldValue
functions.input: the display string, the raw value, and the field key
functions.output: a clickable labelled link when the raw value is an http(s) URL, otherwise the plain display text
functions.if_none: non-URL values render exactly as before via the display string

values: N/A - display only; no regulatory values.
queries: N/A - no database or API query.

break_it.scenario: A non-URL string that starts with http-like text
break_it.repro: the test is /^https?:///i — requires an actual http(s):// prefix
break_it.how: anchored regex only matches genuine URLs

break_it.scenario: A URL field with a null/empty value
break_it.repro: raw must be a string matching the URL regex; null/empty falls through to the display text
break_it.how: typeof raw === 'string' guard plus the regex

break_it.scenario: The full-row span breaks the bento layout on small screens
break_it.repro: the span is col-span-1 on mobile, widening only at md/xl
break_it.how: responsive span: 1 col on mobile, 2 at md, 3 at xl

post_merge.manual_verify: Open a brief: the DCP Controls card spans the full row and its URL is a clickable 'Open the DCP document (PDF)' link; the Planning Controls legislation URL is also a link.
